The camera tracks the full aerial so every rotation reads clearly. <rushing air, wing snap> End state: Fuzzby at the top of his arc, fully opened out, beginning to fall.

Shot 4 — the button. He drops and sets down in a superhero landing, frame-left: one leg extended, one knee bent, arms wide, head lowered, pollen bursting outward around him. He stays down for a beat. Then his head snaps up and his eyes dart left, then right. He looks down at his own body and pats his chest, checking he is intact. The realisation lands: he is completely fine. Only then does his chest inflate, his chin lift and his arms spread wide with total conviction, as if he meant every second of it.
